metadata.notes: Business questions (q6-q11) only shown if user is NOT pre_ladder on wealth ladder

questions.question: Where are you in your business journey?
questions.subtext: Be honest - there's no wrong answer

options.label: Exploring from my day job
options.description: I'm employed, searching for what to build

options.label: Building on the side
options.description: I'm employed, growing something alongside my job

options.label: Gone solo, finding my footing
options.description: I've left employment, still building momentum

options.label: Scaling what I've built
options.description: I'm self-employed with paying clients

questions.question: What have you created so far?
questions.subtext: Think about what you're currently offering or selling

options.label: Still discovering
options.description: Nothing concrete yet, exploring possibilities

options.label: Trading my time
options.description: A service where I work with clients directly

options.label: Packaged offerings
options.description: Courses, programs, or fixed-scope packages

options.label: Products people buy
options.description: Digital products, software, or physical goods

questions.question: What would help you most right now?

options.label: Clarity on my path
options.description: Finally knowing what I'm meant to build

options.label: An offer that resonates
options.description: Creating something people actually want

options.label: Consistent clients
options.description: Landing paying customers regularly

options.label: Scale and systems
options.description: Growing what's already working

questions.question: What emotion do you feel most about your business progress right now?
questions.subtext: Be honest - this helps us understand where you're at

options.label: Excited
options.description: Things are clicking and I'm energized

options.label: Hopeful
options.description: I believe it's coming together

options.label: Motivated
options.description: Ready to take action and make it happen

options.label: Frustrated
options.description: I've tried things and they're not working

options.label: Overwhelmed
options.description: Too many options, don't know where to focus

options.label: Lost
options.description: I don't know what to do next

options.label: Stuck
options.description: I know what to do but can't seem to move

questions.question: How long have you been feeling this way?
questions.subtext: Plateaus are normal - this helps us understand your situation

options.label: Just recently
options.description: This feeling is new

options.label: A few months
options.description: Been building for a while

options.label: 6-12 months
options.description: Been stuck for a while

options.label: 1-2 years
options.description: Long-term plateau

options.label: 2+ years
options.description: Significantly stuck

questions.question: Do you have an attraction offer?
questions.subtext: A low-friction first purchase that turns strangers into customers

options.label: Yes, and it's converting well
options.description: My front-end offer brings in new customers consistently

options.label: Yes, but not converting
options.description: I have one but people aren't buying

options.label: I have one but it's not clear
options.description: I have something but not positioned as attraction offer

options.label: No attraction offer yet
options.description: I only sell my main/core offer

questions.question: Do you have an upsell?
questions.subtext: A higher-value offer for customers who want to go deeper

options.label: Yes, and it's selling well
options.description: Many customers upgrade to my premium offer

options.label: Yes, but few people buy it
options.description: I have one but conversion is low

options.label: I offer it but not systematically
options.description: I sometimes offer more, but not as a defined upsell

options.label: No upsell offer yet
options.description: I don't have a premium tier

questions.question: Do you have a downsell?
questions.subtext: A lower-priced option for those who can't afford the main offer

options.label: Yes, and it rescues sales
options.description: I capture customers who would otherwise say no

options.label: Yes, but rarely used
options.description: I have one but don't offer it consistently

options.label: I sometimes discount on the spot
options.description: I negotiate price but no defined downsell

options.label: No downsell offer
options.description: If they say no to main offer, that's it

questions.question: Do you have a continuity offer?
questions.subtext: Membership, subscription, retainer, or ongoing service

options.label: Yes, strong recurring revenue
options.description: Subscriptions/retainers are a significant income stream

options.label: Yes, but small base
options.description: I have recurring revenue but it's not the main income

options.description: I launched something recurring but it didn't stick

options.description: All my sales are one-time transactions

questions.subtext: Do you know what % of leads become customers at each stage?

options.description: I know my numbers at every stage of the funnel

options.description: I know some conversion rates but not the full picture

options.description: I know leads in and sales out, not much in between

options.label: No funnel tracking
options.description: I don't measure conversion rates

options.label: Yes, but not using it well
options.description: I have one but it's not fully set up or used
